milestone.title: Backlog + Ideas 2nd-line description / body preview in raul

intent.outcome: Every Backlog and Ideas list row in the raul TUI gains a 2nd-line preview below the title: Backlog items show the continuation of their description (or collapsed to 'resolved · <resolution>' for resolved rows); Ideas show the first line of their body. The preview is dim color with a `↳` prefix, truncated to fit the column. BacklogItem gains a `created` field (serde default empty, no migration) that sets up a future age/since column slice.

problem.description: Today `render_backlog_list` (shared by the Backlog and Ideas lanes) renders each row as a single line: `ID · Title · Priority · Status`. The title is the first line of the BacklogItem description (or the IdeaEntry title). To see the actual content the user has to press Enter to open the detail. With 156 backlog items + 31 mixed-in BF/TW/ID items, scanning the list tells you almost nothing about the substance of each item. Ideas have a `body` field on disk that never makes it to the list at all. The Milestones tab got per-stage tracking in M202; the Backlog/Ideas tabs still feel like a flat index.

in_scope: Add `created: String` (serde default empty) to `BacklogItem` in `crates/mp-model/src/track.rs`. No migration; legacy items load fine with empty `created`.

Update `mp list backlog` projection in `crates/mp/src/commands/list.rs` to add a `preview` field per item: continuation of `description` (everything after the first line), truncated to ~80 chars with `...` for active items; `resolved · <resolution>` for resolved items; `''` (empty) for items with no description continuation.
Update `mp list ideas` projection to add a `preview` field per item: first line of `body`, truncated to ~80 chars with `...`; `''` for items with no body.
Extend `BacklogLine` in `crates/raul/src/tui/app.rs` with `preview: String`. Update `parse_backlog_lines` in `crates/raul/src/tui/runner_helpers.rs` to populate it from the new payload field.

Update `render_backlog_list` in `crates/raul/src/tui/render/lane_lists.rs` (shared by the Backlog and Ideas lanes) to render 2-line rows. Each logical row produces 2 visual rows: title (bold, normal color) + preview (dim color, `↳` prefix, ~80-char truncation). The selected-row highlight spans both visual rows. Selected-index continues to address logical rows. Ideas get the same layout because they share this renderer.
Compact-mode (narrow terminal) renders the same 2-line layout but with reduced column widths. Same preview content; truncation may kick in earlier.

Tests: unit tests for the preview-projection logic (active vs resolved, with/without description continuation, with/without body); TUI snapshot tests for the new 2-line layout (wide + compact widths) on both Backlog and Ideas; round-trip serde test for the new `created` field on BacklogItem.
out_of_scope: Rendering the `created` field — the age/since column slice is a separate milestone. The field is added to the schema now so that slice is purely a renderer change.

Merging BF/TW items from canonical `master-plan/tracks/{bugfix,tweak}.json` into the list payload. Today's `mp list backlog` returns stale copies from `backlog.json`; the preview uses the legacy `description` for those. Documenting the data hygiene gap as a future backlog item rather than fixing it in this slice.
Merging ID items from canonical `master-plan/ideas.json` — same reasoning.
Changing the Backlog list column grammar (still 4 columns: ID, Title, Priority, Status) or sort options (still Id, Title, Priority, Status).
Adding new affordances like `mp backlog promote` from the TUI — out of scope; existing CLI behavior preserved.

Editing the BacklogItem description semantics — `description` continues to play the title-equivalent role (first line is the row title, lines 2+ are the preview). No rename or split into separate `title`+`body` fields.
Editing the IdeaEntry model — `body` field already exists and is the canonical preview source.
Head or middle truncation — Q-01 already pinned tail truncation with `...` via `text::truncate`.
Animating or transitioning rows when content changes — preview is a static projection.

design_decisions.choice: Description continuation for active items; resolved · resolution for resolved items; first line of body for Ideas
design_decisions.rationale: Matches how each model already structures its content. BacklogItem.description has the title on line 1 and the rest of the content on subsequent lines; truncating to the first ~80 chars of line 2+ gives a meaningful preview without needing new fields. IdeaEntry.body is a long-form field whose first line is the natural preview. No schema split needed.

design_decisions.choice: Use legacy description from backlog.json (same as BL/B-*); do not merge canonical tracks/{bugfix,tweak}.json
design_decisions.rationale: Today's mp list backlog returns 151 items all from backlog.json (legacy). Merging canonical sources is a bigger change and a data hygiene fix on its own. Slice keeps the existing data flow; documents the gap as a future backlog item.

design_decisions.choice: Collapse to resolved · resolution (NOT full description continuation)
design_decisions.rationale: Resolved items already carry their resolution text in the existing Status column; duplicating the full description wastes vertical space. The collapsed form keeps the row compact and surfaces the resolution directly without Enter.

The ↳ prefix adds scan-ability without using horizontal space (the title column already starts indented). Dim color is the established visual idiom for secondary content in this TUI (Stages section checklist, scope items).

design_decisions.choice: 2 visual rows per logical row; selected-index addresses logical rows
design_decisions.rationale: Matches the new info density without breaking the existing navigation model. Scroll offset accounts for 2 visual rows per logical row. Selected-row highlight spans both rows so the cursor stays visible.

design_decisions.choice: Add created field with serde default empty; no migration
design_decisions.rationale: The created field is needed for the future age/since column slice. Adding it now (no migration, no consumer) lets the next slice be a pure renderer change instead of a schema + renderer change.

design_decisions.choice: Keep 4 columns (ID, Title, Priority, Status); preview is a 2nd-line annotation, not a column
design_decisions.rationale: The Milestones tab carries position info in a dedicated Stage column; the Backlog tab doesn't have a stage concept. A 2nd-line annotation keeps the column grammar unchanged (avoids horizontal re-budgeting) and follows the precedent of the Milestones Stages section.

open_questions.question: For preview text that exceeds 80 chars after the first line of description (or first line of body), should truncation be head, middle, or tail?
open_questions.answer: Tail truncate with ... at 80 chars. Use the existing text::truncate helper (crates/raul/src/text.rs) for grapheme-safe truncation. Preview preserves the lead context, which is what users scan for.

open_questions.question: For BF/TW items whose legacy `description` has only one line (title + no continuation), what shows in the preview line — empty, a (no description) placeholder, or fall back to the Status column?
open_questions.answer: Empty preview line. When the legacy description has only the title line (no continuation), the preview row is rendered with only the ↳ prefix and nothing after. The Status column already carries the relevant signal; no placeholder needed.
